sentences.text: The Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme was established by Letters Patent on 18 August 2022 to inquire into the Robodebt Scheme, a debt assessment and recovery scheme.

cites.document: Report of the Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme

sentences.support: The Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme was established by Letters Patent on 18 August 2022

sentences.text: The Commission examined how, by whom and why the Scheme was established, designed and implemented, how concerns and complaints were managed, the use of third-party debt collectors, and the Scheme's human and economic effects.

cites.document: Report of the Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme

sentences.support: how, by whom and why the scheme was established, designed, implemented

sentences.text: The Commission found that the Scheme relied heavily on income averaging to assess income and entitlement to benefit.

cites.document: Report of the Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme

sentences.support: relied heavily on a process known as “income averaging” to assess income and entitlement to benefit

sentences.text: The Commission described Robodebt as a crude and cruel mechanism, neither fair nor legal, and a costly failure of public administration in both human and economic terms.
